title: LTV System
text: Simulate linear time-varying (LTV) systems, 2 inputs, 5 outputs, {Interpolation method} sets Interpolation method; {State-space array} sets the array of state-space models ss or idss model, {Initial condition source} sets the option to set initial condition using external signal, {Initial condition}, {Operating Point Offsets} sets the offset specification format Specify Offsets as double, {Input offset}, {Output offset}, {State offset}, {State derivative/update offset} sets the state derivative or update, {Struct array} sets the offsets structure array, {Coefficients To Fix} sets the fixed coefficients of state-space matrices false, {Read values from} sets the source for values of fixed coefficients First model in state-space, {Extrapolation method}, {Index search method} sets the prelookup algorithm Binary, {Begin index search using previous index result} sets the begin search at previous time step, {Block data type (discrete-time case only)} sets the block data type, {Initial buffer size for delays} and {Use fixed buffer size}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: State-space array
params.values: Array of state-space models ss or idss model array

params.name: Initial condition source
params.values: Option to set initial condition using external signal internal (default) | external

params.name: Operating Point Offsets
params.values: Offset specification format Specify Offsets as double arrays (default) | Specify offsets as struct array | Use offsets in state-space array

params.name: State derivative/update offset
params.values: State derivative or update offset array

params.name: Struct array
params.values: Offsets structure array struct (default) | structure array name

params.name: Coefficients To Fix
params.values: Fixed coefficients of state-space matrices false or 0 (default) | true or 1 | logical matrix

params.name: Read values from
params.values: Source for values of fixed coefficients First model in state-space array (default) | Custom state-space model

params.name: Index search method
params.values: Prelookup algorithm Binary search (default) | Linear search

params.name: Begin index search using previous index result
params.values: Begin search at previous time step on (default) | off

params.name: Initial buffer size for delays
params.values: Initial buffer size 1024 (default) | positive integer greater than 5

params.name: Use fixed buffer size
params.values: Use fixed buffer size off (default) | on
